runtimePolicy.notes: Atmosphere plays around the song. Songs play through the YouTube player, which a page cannot process, so venue acoustics apply only to the atmosphere layers. Claps and dandiya sticks are synthesised at runtime and follow the listener's taps.

sources.title: Country Night Noise
sources.author: hc (PDSounds.org via Wikimedia Commons)
sources.notes: Crickets and night air, used for the Party plot and Sheri venues. The .m4a is an AAC transcode of the same recording for Safari.

sources.title: Festival Concert People Crowd
sources.author: stephan (PDSounds.org via Wikimedia Commons)
sources.notes: Crowd chatter under the music. An automated check found no sustained pitch or regular beat in it. The .m4a is an AAC transcode of the same recording for Safari.
